scope: The fixture preserves only the three archived Node contract cases and is not exhaustive Node/Java parity. javaDetailProjection is Service output, not an archived Node assertion. Java derives technicalSheetUrl from the exact model-level specification source URL using the same ficha-tecnica pathname rule as Node's page classifier.

javaOnlyMissingEvidence.expectation: A present catalog row with no price, source URLs, facts, or observed time stays unknown; no values are synthesized. The archived Node fixture has no corresponding assertion.

unverifiedCapabilities: compare_vehicles input is not currently compatible: Node accepts {models, detail}; Java accepts {vehicles}

compare_vehicles output projection is not currently compatible: Node returns a compact array; default summary limits specifications to 5, omits features and missingSpecificationNames, and reports specificationCount/specificationsOmitted; detail=full includes all specifications and features
missing observation/source behavior in the archived Node contract
get_page_links adds a Java-only knownSource field; Node compacts only sourceUrl, title, totalLinks, offset, limit, and links shaped as {url, text, type, internal}

get_vehicle_provenance: Node returns nullable {document_id, document_type, content_hash, source_url, crawled_at, page_content_hash}; Java exposes Optional with camelCase names and adds title/model/year/trim; absent-ID/null equivalence is unverified
get_catalog_status: Node returns pages, vehicles, documents, embedded, pending, latest_crawled_at; Java adds model/sync counts and uses latestPageCrawlAt instead of latest_crawled_at
